title: Journaling Frequency and Word Count
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=journal:entry
| timechart span=1w count as entries, sum(word_count) as words
description: Trends how often you journal and how much you write, keeping a reflective habit from quietly lapsing.
value: Writing frequency is the habit that matters; trending it reveals the busy weeks when reflection slipped away.
implementation: Ingest journal metadata into `index=personal`; schedule weekly and trend entries and words.
visualization: Column chart of weekly journal entries with word-count overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how often and how much you write in your journal, so the reflective habit does not fade.
